title: johannesnicolaus/egapx_nf pipeline parameters
description: Prepare RNA-seq evidence (rRNA removal, subsampling, name sanitising) and run NCBI EGAPx on many genomes

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Genomes samplesheet: one row per genome (genome_id, fasta, evidence_group, taxid, size_class, reference_gff).
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reads.description: RNA-seq evidence samplesheet: one row per library or long-read run (evidence_group, library, read_type, fastq_1, fastq_2, sra, condition).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

evidence_options.title: RNA-seq evidence options
evidence_options.description: Preparation of the reads given to EGAPx.

max_pairs_per_library.description: Subsample each short-read library to at most this many read pairs (libraries below the cap are used whole).

subsample_seed.description: Seed for seqtk subsampling (same for R1 and R2).

one_per_condition.description: Keep only one short-read library per (evidence_group, condition): the one with the largest R1 file.

remove_rrna.description: Remove rRNA read pairs with BBDuk before subsampling.

rrna_fasta.description: rRNA reference for BBDuk. Default: rRNA genes found by barrnap (eukaryotic models) in one genome per taxid.

save_prepared_reads.description: Publish the prepared (rRNA-free, subsampled) reads in the output directory.

skip_fastqc.description: Skip FastQC of the prepared short reads.

egapx_options.title: EGAPx options
egapx_options.description: How the official NCBI EGAPx release is obtained and run.

egapx_version.description: EGAPx release to use: tag v<version> of https://github.com/ncbi/egapx and container ncbi/egapx:<version>.

egapx_cache_dir.description: Directory for the EGAPx code, launcher venv, container image and support data. Can be shared between runs.

egapx_workdir.description: Persistent directory for EGAPx work and output per genome; needed so failed genomes resume. Use fast scratch storage writable from compute nodes.

egapx_executor.description: EGAPx executor: 'slurm' submits EGAPx tasks to Slurm; 'singularity'/'docker' run them on the machine of the head job.

egapx_cluster_options.description: Extra Slurm options for EGAPx tasks (e.g. '-C zen2').

egapx_queue_size.description: Maximum number of EGAPx tasks queued at once per genome.

egapx_threads.description: Threads for multi-threaded EGAPx tasks (EGAPx params.threads).

egapx_container.description: EGAPx container to use instead of ncbi/egapx:<version> (path to a .sif or an image URI).

egapx_bind_paths.description: Comma-separated paths to bind into the EGAPx container (genome, reads and work directories must be visible).

egapx_extra_config.description: Extra Nextflow config included in the EGAPx executor config (e.g. process resources).

egapx_extra_yaml.description: YAML lines appended to every EGAPx input file (e.g. additional_proteins, max_intron).

egapx_env_setup.description: Shell commands run before EGAPx steps on the host, e.g. 'module load python/3.11.4 singularity Nextflow2'.

egapx_python.description: Python >= 3.11 used to create the EGAPx launcher venv.

egapx_head_time.description: Time limit of each per-genome EGAPx head job.

keep_egapx_work.description: Keep the EGAPx work directory of each genome after success (deleted by default).

max_parallel_small.description: Maximum number of 'small' genomes run by EGAPx at the same time.

max_parallel_large.description: Maximum number of 'large' genomes run by EGAPx at the same time.

qc_options.title: Annotation QC options
qc_options.description: BUSCO and comparison with reference annotations.

busco_lineage.description: BUSCO lineage (e.g. metazoa_odb10, or auto_euk). Default: the lineage EGAPx chose from the taxid.

busco_mode.description: BUSCO mode, run on the longest protein (or transcript) per gene.

busco_lineages_path.description: BUSCO download directory (containing lineages/). Default: EGAPx's BUSCO download in --egapx_cache_dir.

skip_reference_comparison.description: Skip the comparison with reference_gff annotations.

rename_options.title: Gene ID options
rename_options.description: Stable, genome-unique IDs for the EGAPx annotation.

skip_rename.description: Do not rename; keep EGAPx's temporary egapxtmp_ IDs.

gene_id_step.description: Step between consecutive gene numbers along a chromosome (gaps allow inserting genes later).

gene_id_digits.description: Zero-padded width of the gene number.
